fact: The General Information Authority reported on 2026-04-23 that it applies the National Guide for Government Data Governance as the reference framework for data management, quality and the responsibilities of entities, and pressed the Libyan Zakat Fund to align its platforms with it.

fact: The General Information Authority issued version 1.1 of the National Policy for Government Data Governance in December 2022, covering the government data lifecycle, classification, sharing and ownership across all government bodies; the document gives no separate approval date, so its imprint month is used.
